comment: Written by generators/senses (sensescases) from RFC 5545 at its pinned bytes and app/specs/senses/clocks.json: do not edit. Each example is a 'flat' request of the senses guest and its answer at one pinned clock. The time zone is the TZID of the RFC's VTIMEZONE example. The request holds, as 'held' lines, every VEVENT of the RFC's iCalendar objects that gives DTSTART and DTEND in UTC, with its UID, start and end as the RFC prints them, written as RFC 3339; the answer names the one under way at the clock and the next to begin, chosen here apart from the guest.
examples:
flat
base https://example.com/me/
now 1996-09-18T15:00:00Z
zone America/New_York
held 1997-07-14T17:00:00Z 1997-07-15T04:00:00Z 19970610T172345Z-AF23B2@example.com
held 1996-09-18T14:30:00Z 1996-09-20T22:00:00Z uid1@example.com
held 1997-03-24T12:30:00Z 1997-03-24T21:00:00Z uid3@example.com
timeZone America/New_York
scheduleNow 1996-09-18T14:30:00Z/1996-09-20T22:00:00Z uid1@example.com
scheduleNext 1997-03-24T12:30:00Z/1997-03-24T21:00:00Z uid3@example.com
